description: BAL-05 and BAL-06 (owner decisions 2026-11-27). (1) The solo-fight rule applies at every level: SOLO_ENEMY_CURVE.high continues the solo multipliers from level 15 (points with linear interpolation) and the two-enemy cap for solo encounters no longer stops at level 14. (2) GROUP_ENEMY_CURVE: each group quest (size 3 and 5, not dungeons) gets one power budget (damage its pack deals while being killed one by one; goal quests use the fight's average enemy x packSize) scaled to a target per quest size, a per-level correction and a per-quest correction (tune) calibrated with the simulator, so that three heroes of the quest level win normally and two heroes practically lose unless the companion is a strong epic/legendary and the main is levelled and geared. encounterCurve() gives the full multiplier for the enemy summary. Measured with scripts/sim_campaign.cjs (docs/evidence/bal-05-06/).
